info.title: Quad API
info.description: School, parent and console routes. Errors are `{ code, message, fields? }`.

etag.description: The version to send back as If-Match with a change. Send this value from the body, not the ETag header: a proxy may weaken the header (W/), and a weak tag is refused.

503.description: A dependency is down; the body names it

post.summary: SES bounce and complaint events from SNS (signature version 2, pinned topic)

get.summary: The signed-in person, their school and brand, other schools, banners and greeting

patch.summary: Change your name, theme or locale in this school (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: What you can do in this school: permission keys, every staff page and how much of it opens, your home page and any role preview

post.summary: Preview the staff portal as a role, read-only (users.manage; a role for own classes needs a sample person; needs X-CSRF-Token)

delete.summary: End the role preview: back to your own view (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Sign one of your devices out (needs X-CSRF-Token)

post.summary: Set up an authenticator: without a code it starts one, with its code it confirms it and gives the recovery codes (needs X-CSRF-Token)

200.description: The otpauth URI, or the recovery codes

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookies and says what comes next
Check the authenticator or recovery code at the two-step step (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: The schools you can open (Choose a school, Switch school)

post.summary: Open one of your schools. Staff: rotates the session cookie (needs X-CSRF-Token). Parent app: the select_school token gets both tokens; a school token switches and gets only the new access token (the refresh token stays)

200.description: Parent app (bearer): the tokens for the school

204.description: Staff (cookie): signed in to the school

post.summary: Sign out: the staff session for every school (needs X-CSRF-Token), or the parent app’s token family on this device
Send a 6-digit sign-in code to a mobile number or email (the same answer whether or not it is known)

202.description: A code is on its way; it works for 10 minutes

post.summary: Check the code: signs in to your one school, asks you to choose among several, or says you were not found
Swap the refresh token for a new pair; an old refresh token signs the device out everywhere it was copied

200.description: The new access and refresh tokens

post.summary: Email a password reset link (the same answer whether or not the account exists)

202.description: If the account exists, a reset link is on its way

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link; signs out every device
Console: sign in with email and password; sets the console cookies and asks for the authenticator code (or to set one up)
Console, first sign-in: a new authenticator secret and its otpauth URI, shown once (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Console: check the authenticator code (or the first code of a new one) and open the console on a new cookie (needs X-CSRF-Token)
Console: sign out this browser and clear the console cookies (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: Console: the signed-in Quad staff member’s name and role

Console → Audit log: every school’s platform_audit entries, newest first, filtered by Quad staff member, school, action and time (any console role). With Accept: text/csv, every filtered entry as a CSV download (the export is recorded; more than 10,000 entries is 422)

200.description: A page of the log, or the CSV export

schema.description: RFC 4180 CSV with a header row (UTF-8)

get.summary: Console → Audit log: the Quad staff who appear as the actor of an entry, by name, for the actor filter (any console role)

200.description: The Quad staff in the log

get.summary: Console → Schools: every school that is not deleted, by name, with its id, short name, status and colour (any console role)

post.summary: Console → Open as school admin: with a reason (10 to 500 characters), opens a 60-minute support visit to the school and returns a single-use link into the staff portal that works for 2 minutes (support, admin or owner role; needs X-CSRF-Token)

Staff portal, /sign-in/support/{token}: use a support visit’s single-use link from the console and open the school as Quad support; sets the staff cookies until the visit ends. Every bad, used or expired link is 400 invalid_link
Staff portal, Exit to platform: end this support visit, clear the staff cookies and return the console’s address (the visit’s own cookie; needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: Staff accounts with role, status, two-step and last sign-in, and the summary (users.manage)

post.summary: Invite 1 to 50 people by email with a role; an address already on the staff is 422 already_member, a family member’s 422 family_member (needs X-CSRF-Token)

patch.summary: Change a member’s role, or deactivate or reactivate them; never yourself, never the last admin (needs X-CSRF-Token)

post.summary: Email the member to turn on two-step sign-in (409 when it is on)

202.description: Email the member to turn on two-step sign-in (409 when it is on)

post.summary: Email the member a single-use link to choose a new password

202.description: Email the member a single-use link to choose a new password

post.summary: Sign the member out of every device in this school

204.description: Sign the member out of every device in this school

post.summary: Send a pending invitation again with a new link; the old link stops working

202.description: Send a pending invitation again with a new link; the old link stops working

get.summary: A staff invitation: the school, the name, the masked address and whether a password is needed (signed link)

post.summary: Accept a staff invitation: a new account chooses its password and is signed in; an existing account must be signed in (signed link)

get.summary: Every role of the school with its members, pages, home page and matrix (users.manage or settings.view)

post.summary: Create a custom role from another role's permissions, or from none (users.manage; needs X-CSRF-Token)

patch.summary: Change a custom role's name, description, colour or scope; a built-in role is 422 system_role_locked (needs X-CSRF-Token)

delete.summary: Delete a custom role nobody holds or previews (409 in_use otherwise; needs X-CSRF-Token)

put.summary: Replace a custom role's matrix and sensitive keys: rows in the plan only, keys you hold yourself (needs X-CSRF-Token)

get.summary: School settings → General, with the read-only time zone, branding and sign-in rules (managed by Quad), the summary and the etag (settings.view)

patch.summary: Change General (name, office email and phone, address, SMS sender ID); Quad’s fields are refused with 400, a stale If-Match with 409 (settings.edit; needs X-CSRF-Token)

schema.description: The `etag` value from the last response body, sent as it is. Do not copy the ETag header: a proxy may weaken it (W/), and a weak tag is refused with 409.

parameters.description: The `etag` value from the last response body, sent as it is. Do not copy the ETag header: a proxy may weaken it (W/), and a weak tag is refused with 409.
parameters.name: if-match

get.summary: The school’s colour and logo, set by Quad (any signed-in member)
The school’s other settings, read-only for now (settings.view)

Settings → Audit: the school’s audit log, newest first, filtered by person, action and time (settings.view). With Accept: text/csv, every filtered entry as a CSV download (needs sensitive.export_data; the export is audited; more than 10,000 entries is 422)

200.description: A page of the log, or the CSV export

schema.description: RFC 4180 CSV with a header row (UTF-8)

get.summary: Settings → Audit: the school’s members who appear in its log, by name, for the person filter (settings.view)

post.summary: An admissions enquiry from a school’s public form, found by its embed key (20 a minute per address; every key is unknown until M4)
